topUp.title: Top up
topUp.subtitle: Send USDT with Binance Pay to Kuulis' account. No fees, instant.
topUp.unavailable: Kuulis hasn't set up its Binance Pay account yet. Try again later or contact support.
topUp.step1: Open Binance and go to Pay → Send.
topUp.step2: Paste Kuulis' Pay ID ({{payId}}) and check the name is {{name}}.
topUp.step3: Send {{min}} USDT or more from your account (Pay ID {{payerId}}).
topUp.step4Auto: Done: your balance is credited automatically within minutes.
topUp.step4Manual: Tap "I've paid" to let us know and we'll confirm your payment.
topUp.autoBody: We detect your payment because it comes from your Binance Pay ID ({{payerId}}). Always pay from that account. If it doesn't show up within 15 minutes, tell us with "I've paid".
topUp.manualBody: An admin reviews every payment, usually within a few hours. Tell us with "I've paid" and the order ID so we can find it fast.
topUp.paidHint: Let us know you sent the payment

binance.title: Your Binance Pay ID
binance.subtitleAuto: We use it to recognize your payments and credit them automatically, without you telling us.
binance.subtitleManual: We use it to recognize your payments and confirm them faster.
binance.label: Binance Pay ID
binance.invalid: Enter your Binance Pay ID: numbers only, 6 to 20 digits.
binance.where1: Open the Binance app and tap Pay.
binance.where3: Copy the number shown as Pay ID and paste it here.
binance.whereNote: It isn't your email, your UID or a wallet address.
binance.privacy: We only use it to identify your top-ups. We'll never ask for your Binance passwords or codes.

notify.title: I've paid
notify.subtitle: Tell us how much you sent so we can find your payment.

notify.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 5.00
notify.referenceHint: You'll find it in the payment details, in your Binance Pay history.
notify.noteAuto: If the payment already arrived, it's credited automatically even if you don't tell us.
notify.noteManual: An admin confirms the payment and we'll notify you. You can have up to 3 notices waiting for confirmation.

sent.title: Notice sent!
sent.bodyAuto: If your payment already reached Kuulis, your balance will update within minutes. We'll send you a notification.
sent.bodyManual: An admin will confirm your payment and we'll notify you when it's in your balance.

charges.title: Fees
charges.subtitle: Charged on the 1st of each month based on what you earned the month before.
charges.emptyBody: Your first fee is calculated on the 1st of the month after your first rides.
charges.howBody: Based on what you earn in the month (the prices of your completed rides):
charges.howNote: A month with no rides is free. Your first 3 months from your first ride are free. If your balance falls short, you have 7 days to top up.

report.categorySubtitleRide: Tell us about your ride on {{date}}.
report.categorySubtitleGeneral: Pick a topic. If it happened on a ride, report it from Your rides so we can look into it.

safety.title: I felt unsafe
safety.body: Something during the ride put your safety at risk

fare.title: Charged a different amount
fare.body: The amount was not what the app showed

vehicle_mismatch.title: Bike or person didn't match
vehicle_mismatch.body: The plate, bike or person weren't the ones in the app

no_show.title: They didn't show up
no_show.body: The other person never came to the meeting point

lost_item.title: Lost item
lost_item.body: You left something on the bike or found something

app_issue.title: App problem
app_issue.body: Something didn't work as it should

placeholder.safety: Tell us what happened, where and when. Everything you remember helps.
placeholder.harassment: Tell us what they said or did. We handle it with full discretion.
placeholder.driving: What happened? For example: going too fast, running a red light, no helmet…
placeholder.fare: How much was charged or paid, and how much did the app show?
placeholder.vehicle_mismatch: What didn't match? The plate, the bike's color, the person…
placeholder.no_show: How long did you wait? Could you reach them through the chat?
placeholder.lost_item: What was left behind and what does it look like? If it was on a ride, we'll help you reach the other person.
placeholder.app_issue: What were you doing and what happened? If you saw an error message, paste it here.

urgent.title: We treat this as urgent
urgent.body: The Kuulis team reviews these reports first. If you are in danger right now, call 911.

report.detailsSubtitle: More details help us help you. Only the Kuulis team will read it.
